vectors.name: unbacked-authority-expansion
vectors.assertion: Effective authority MUST NOT expand without an identifiable authorization basis.

vectors.name: revocation-after-admission
vectors.assertion: Authority required for a protected effect MUST remain valid at the point of effect.

vectors.name: alternate-path-bypass
vectors.assertion: Retry, fallback, alternate-tool selection, or delegation MUST NOT reset an authority denial under unchanged authorization state.

vectors.name: equivalent-effect-substitution
vectors.assertion: An alternate representation of the same protected effect MUST NOT automatically reset the authority decision.

vectors.name: concurrent-authority-double-spend
vectors.assertion: Committed effects plus outstanding delegated authority MUST remain within the authoritative budget.

vectors.name: reclaim-versus-late-commit
vectors.assertion: COMMITTED and RECLAIMED MUST be mutually exclusive for the same reservation generation.

vectors.name: stale-authority-during-partition
vectors.assertion: A protected effect MUST fail closed when current authority cannot be established.
